description.fun: Cosmog is a fluffy little nebula so light that a breeze can blow it away, which it doesn't seem to mind. It's trusting and curious, warming to anyone kind to it and wandering into danger, then teleporting away when things get dicey; under great stress it can even tear open Ultra Wormholes, at terrible risk to itself. Ancient Alolans called it 'the child of the stars'.
description.guide: Cosmog is a Psychic-type Legendary Pokémon from Alola with a gaseous body like a nebula, and one of the lightest Pokémon. It grows by gathering dust from the air and evolves into Cosmoem at level 43. It plays a central role in the story of Sun and Moon.
description.tagline: A trusting little nebula known as the child of the stars

description.fun: Cosmoem is a tiny golden cocoon that can't move and seemingly can't even eat; it grows by soaking up starlight and dust. It's one of the shortest Pokémon, yet it weighs 999.9 kg, tied with Celesteela as the heaviest of all, and its shell is said to be harder than any known material. Ancient Alolans called it the 'cocoon of the stars'.
description.guide: Cosmoem is a Psychic-type Legendary Pokémon that evolves from Cosmog. It cannot move inside its hard shell, gathering energy until it evolves at level 53 into Solgaleo or Lunala, depending on the game. It is tied with Celesteela as the heaviest Pokémon.
description.tagline: A tiny star cocoon that weighs nearly a tonne

branches.text: Which Pokémon Cosmoem becomes depends on the game: it evolves into Solgaleo in Sun, Ultra Sun, Sword and Scarlet, and into Lunala in Moon, Ultra Moon, Shield and Violet. As it evolves it glows orange for Solgaleo or purple for Lunala.

description.fun: Solgaleo, once called 'the beast that devours the sun', is a white lion whose blazing light can make night look like midday, and its solar energy can sway Rockruff to evolve into Midday Form Lycanroc. It lives in Ultra Space and can open wormholes to travel there, so the Ultra Recon Squad ride it. Necrozma hunts it endlessly to steal its light.
description.guide: Solgaleo is a Psychic- and Steel-type Legendary Pokémon, the mascot of Pokémon Sun and one of Cosmoem's two final forms. It is an emissary of the sun that can travel to and from Ultra Space. Necrozma can fuse with it to become Dusk Mane Necrozma.
description.tagline: A sun lion whose light turns night into midday

description.fun: Lunala, once called 'the beast that calls the moon', is a skeletal bat whose spread wings glitter like a crescent moon in a vast night sky, and its power can shroud daylight in darkness. It soaks up light and turns it into energy, and its lunar energy can sway Rockruff to evolve into Midnight Form Lycanroc. Like Solgaleo, it's endlessly hunted by Necrozma, which wants to devour its light.
description.guide: Lunala is a Psychic- and Ghost-type Legendary Pokémon, the mascot of Pokémon Moon and one of Cosmoem's two final forms. It is an emissary of the moon that can travel to and from Ultra Space. Necrozma can fuse with it to become Dawn Wings Necrozma.
description.tagline: A moon bat whose wings hold the whole night sky

transitions.how: Level 53, in Sun, Ultra Sun, Sword or Scarlet
Level 53, in Moon, Ultra Moon, Shield or Violet
